title: 第25章 立她为郡主第26章 她竟然是天才级学员
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 秦云扫了黑袍老妪等人一眼，然后才说道：“在来大乾学府之前，我对大乾学府充满了向往，可是在看到大乾学府这些所谓的高层后，我很庆幸没有加入大乾学府。”
“一个连原本订好的规矩都能随意打破的学府，未来注定不会有前途。”
“再说了，大乾王城又不是只有一个学府。”
黑袍老妪等高层脸色发黑。
如果是天才说这些话，他们还能忍受。
像秦云这种走体修道路，靠着体魄优势的家伙，当着众人的面贬低大乾学府，他们可忍不了。
“你以为你是什么东西？要不是背后有人倚仗，你能站在这里？”
黑袍老妪冷声说道：“凭着体魄占据些许优势就目中无人，你该不会以为你战胜了他们两个，就战胜了我们大乾学府的所有学员？”
“狂妄自大，不知天高地厚的东西，我大乾学府的学员实力超群，随便一个出来都能碾压你！”
秦云将从风子皓那里弄到的长剑插在地上，“老东西，别说我不给你机会，你派一个先天第六重的学员过来，能赢我的话，我任由你们处置。”
老东西……
黑袍老妪差点气炸了。
虽然她年纪不小了，但是这些年保养得当，表面看起来也就四五十左右而已，竟然被秦云称为老东西。
“这可是你说的！”
黑袍老妪满眼怨怒。
随后，黑袍老妪立即派人去找人，她知道秦云体魄很强，所以她专门找一个克制秦云的学员。
身为地院主，她还是有这个能力的。
她要让秦云知道，什么叫做自寻死路！
风家老祖和蓝袍中年男子没有离去，而是在这里看着，他们没想到秦云竟然会当面挑衅地院主。
这样也好，让地院主派人来对付秦云。
很快，一名体型壮硕的中年男子赶了过来，此人背着双面巨斧，起码有上千斤。
这个中年男子不但天生力大无穷，而且身上还有着浓浓的杀气，明显是长期杀人凝聚出来的杀气。
“一剑！”
秦云说道。
一剑？
什么意思？
黑袍老妪等人皱眉不解。
下一刻，秦云已经拔剑，冲向了中年男子，极境的风凌步，再加上极境的霸剑斩。
万炼剑泛起了烈焰。
银袍老者等人动容了。
这不是烈焰，而是挥动万炼剑斩碎气流的时候，力量和速度达到了惊人的程度，导致气流变得炙热，所以看起来像是烈焰。
霎时！
剑斩而过。
中年男子僵住了，呆呆地看着前方，至于秦云已经出现在他的身后了。
下一刻，中年男子脖子上出现了一道整齐的血痕。
扑通！
中年男子倒在地上，头颅和身体分开了。
content_en:
Qin Yun glanced at the old woman in black robe and others, and then said: "Before coming to Daqian Academy, I was full of yearning for Daqian Academy, but after seeing the so-called senior officials of Daqian Academy, I am very glad that I did not join Daqian Academy."
"A school that can break even its original rules at will is destined to have no future."
"Besides, there is not only one school in Daqian King City."
The old woman in black robe and other senior officials had dark faces.
If a genius said these things, they could stand it.
They couldn't bear it when a guy like Qin Yun who followed the path of physical cultivation and relied on his physical superiority belittled Daqian Academy in front of everyone.
"Who do you think you are? If it weren't for someone relying on you, how could you be standing here?"
The old woman in black robe said coldly: "You are arrogant because you have a slight advantage due to your physical strength. Don't you think that by defeating the two of them, you have defeated all the students in our Daqian Academy?"
"Arrogant and arrogant. I don't know the heights of the world. The students in my Daqian Academy are extremely powerful. Anyone who comes out can crush you!"
Qin Yun stuck the long sword he got from Feng Zihao on the ground, "Old guy, don't say I won't give you a chance. You send a student with the sixth level of innate talent here. If he can beat me, I'll let you do whatever you want."
Old thing...
The old woman in black robe almost exploded with anger.
Although she is not young, she has taken good care of herself over the years and looks like she is only in her forties or fifties, yet she is actually called an old thing by Qin Yun.
"That's what you said!"
The old woman in black robe had angry eyes.
Afterwards, the old woman in black robe immediately sent someone to find someone. She knew that Qin Yun was very strong, so she specially found a student who could restrain Qin Yun.
As the Earth Courtyard Master, she still has this ability.
She wanted Qin Yun to know what it meant to seek death!
The ancestor of the Feng family and the middle-aged man in blue robe did not leave, but watched here. They did not expect that Qin Yun would provoke the master of the courtyard in person.
That's fine, let the Lord of the Earth Academy send people to deal with Qin Yun.
Soon, a sturdy middle-aged man rushed over. This man was carrying a double-sided axe, weighing at least a thousand kilograms.
This middle-aged man was not only born with great strength, but also had a strong murderous aura, which was obviously the result of long-term killing.
"One sword!"
Qin Yun said.
A sword?
What's the meaning?
The old woman in black robe and others frowned in confusion.
The next moment, Qin Yun had already drawn his sword and rushed towards the middle-aged man, using the extreme level of Feng Lingbu and the extreme level of domineering sword slashing.
Wan Lianjian burst into flames.
The silver-robed old man and others were moved.
This is not a raging flame, but when the Ten Thousand Refined Sword is wielded to chop the airflow, the power and speed reach an astonishing level, causing the airflow to become hot, so it looks like a raging flame.
Instantly!
The sword slashed past.
The middle-aged man froze and stared blankly ahead, but Qin Yun had already appeared behind him.
The next moment, a neat line of blood appeared on the middle-aged man's neck.
thump!
The middle-aged man fell to the ground, his head and body separated.
title_en: Chapter 25 Make her the princess Chapter 26 She turns out to be a genius-level student
